field.name: leaders_slug
field.help: Made from the category name, English or Arabic (Air Compressors -> air-compressors, ضواغط هوائية -> dwaght-hwaeya). It cannot be typed.

page.name: leaders_product_data
page.div: Choose the subcategory first: the fields of equipment or of spare parts appear after it.

field.name: public_categ_ids
field.help: The subcategory of the product (for example Generators, Loaders, Filters). It decides the section of the website, the fields shown below, the filters and the link of the product. Inside a section only that section's subcategories are offered. Required.

field.name: leaders_brand_id
field.help: The maker of the product, chosen from the brand list (Marketplace > Configuration > Brands). A main filter on the website and part of the search. Required.

field.name: leaders_model_id
field.help: The model or family of the machine (for example P110-5), from the list of its brand's models. Used in search, and it links the spare parts that fit this machine. Required for equipment.

field.name: leaders_compatible_model_ids
field.help: The equipment models this part fits, one or more. It powers the 'choose your machine' filter and the parts suggested with each machine. Required for spare parts.

field.name: leaders_similar_names
field.placeholder: e.g. diesel genset, مولد ديزل, ماكينة كهربا
field.help: Other names people use for this product, separated by commas, in Arabic or English (for example: diesel genset, مولد ديزل). For a spare part, also write here the numbers of the same part at other makers (for example LF3349, P550162); the part's own number goes in the product name. Search on the website also looks here. Optional, not shown to the customer.

field.name: leaders_tag_ids
field.help: Tags that describe the product (family, type, size such as 'oil filters', '15W-40'). Used for filtering and search, and new tags can be added. Required for spare parts.

field.name: leaders_source_id
field.help: Where the product comes from: Original, China or Egypt. A filter on the website. Required.

field.name: leaders_condition
field.help: New, used or refurbished. A used or refurbished machine also needs the year, the operating hours, the operation video and the meter and data plate photos, and may need an inspection before it is published. Oils and filters are new only. Required.

field.name: leaders_capacity
field.help: The capacity or power of the machine as a number, read with the unit next to it (for example 250 kVA, 3 ton). The most important filter in every equipment category. Required for equipment.

field.name: leaders_capacity_unit
field.help: The unit of the capacity: kVA, kW, ton, cubic metre, ampere, metre or litre. Shown with the capacity.

field.name: leaders_energy_id
field.help: What powers the machine: diesel, petrol, gas, electric or hybrid. A filter on the website.

field.name: leaders_part_number
field.help: The maker's number of the part, exactly as written on it. The first thing a technician searches for. Required for spare parts.

field.name: leaders_alt_numbers
field.help: The numbers of the same part at other makers, separated by commas (for example LF3349, P550162). Search finds the part by any of them. Optional, not shown to the customer.

field.name: leaders_source_ids
field.help: The sources the customer may order this part in (Original, China, Egypt). Empty: only the single source above.

field.name: leaders_capacity
field.help: The size or volume of the part when it matters, for example the litres of an oil pack. Shown in the specifications. Optional.

field.name: leaders_capacity_unit
field.help: The unit of the size or volume (litre, metre...).

field.name: list_price
field.help: The price the customer pays, in the company currency. Empty or zero: the product shows 'request a quote' instead of a price. A price-range filter on the website.

field.name: leaders_listing_type
field.help: Whether the machine is offered for sale or for rent. For rent shows the rental path on the website and needs the rent per day.

field.name: leaders_rent_price_day
field.help: The vendor's rent price for one day. The website shows it with the platform's rent margin added. Required when the machine is for rent.

field.name: qty_available
field.help: The quantity on hand in the warehouses, for information only. Stock is updated from Inventory or by the vendor in their portal.

field.name: leaders_warranty_months
field.help: The warranty length in months, shown on the product card as a buying reason. Required for equipment to be approved.

field.name: leaders_service_ids
field.help: The services a customer can ask for with this product (inspection, installation, delivery...). They are offered on the product page.

field.name: leaders_own_service_ids
field.help: Services the vendor offers himself with this machine. The price is agreed between the vendor and the buyer.

field.name: leaders_warranty_provider
field.help: Who gives the warranty: the vendor, the manufacturer or the platform. Required with the warranty for equipment to be approved.

field.name: leaders_warranty_scope
field.placeholder: What it covers and what it excludes
field.help: What the warranty covers and what it excludes, in a few lines. Shown on the product page.

field.name: leaders_serial
field.help: The serial number of the machine, for records and to tell machines apart. Optional, not a condition for publishing.

field.name: leaders_year
field.help: The year the machine was made. A filter on the website. Required for used and refurbished machines.

field.name: leaders_hours
field.help: How many hours the machine has run, as read on its hour meter. A filter on the website. Required for used and refurbished machines.

field.name: leaders_video_url
field.help: A YouTube or Google Drive link of the machine running. Shown on the product page. Required to approve a used machine; the platform checks every week that the link still works.

field.name: leaders_video_broken
field.help: Set by the weekly check when the video link stopped working. Put a working link to clear it.

field.name: leaders_meter_photo
field.help: A photo of the machine's hour meter, proving the operating hours. For the review only, not shown on the website. Required to approve a used machine.

field.name: leaders_plate_photo
field.help: A photo of the data plate on the machine (maker, model, serial, year), proving the model and the year. For the review only. Required to approve a used machine.

field.name: image_1920
field.help: The main photo of the product, shown on the cards, in search and first on the product page. Required.

field.name: product_template_image_ids
field.help: More photos shown in the product page gallery. Equipment needs at least three photos in all.

field.name: description_sale
field.placeholder: Write the Arabic text, then the English one with the language button.
field.help: The description on the product page: every technical detail that is not a filter. Write the Arabic text, then the English one with the language button.

field.name: leaders_engine
field.help: The engine of the machine (for example Perkins 1106A). Shown in the specifications.

field.name: leaders_engine_size
field.help: The engine size in litres. Shown in the specifications and used by the engine-size filter.

field.name: leaders_prime_power
field.help: The continuous rating of a generator as text (for example 225 kVA). Shown in the specifications.

field.name: leaders_city
field.help: The city where the machine is, as the website's city key (for example cairo). Used by the location filter.

field.name: leaders_slug
field.help: The product's link on the website (/products/slug). Made automatically from the brand and the model or the name (Arabic written in Latin letters). It follows the name until the product is published, then it stays so shared links keep working. It cannot be typed.

field.name: leaders_kind
field.help: The website section of the product (power, equipment, part). Worked out from the subcategory; not typed.

field.name: leaders_out_of_stock
field.help: Shows the product as out of stock on the website; adding it to a cart is refused.

field.name: leaders_featured
field.help: Shows the product in the featured rows of the website's home page.

field.name: leaders_inspection_exempt
field.help: Lets a used product be published without the platform's inspection. Only the administrator can set it.
